title: agentic-workflow runner contract
description: The --json shapes printed by tools/runner.mjs (next, begin, classify, record, status) — a public interface for a supervisor that runs the turn itself. contract_version 1. Versioning rule: every shape is strict, so any added, removed or retyped field ships as a contract_version bump plus a minor plugin version bump with a CHANGELOG line naming the change. A `begin` that cannot start a round prints the `next` shape (its preflight) instead.

start.description: UTC time the lock was taken.

holder.description: The --holder id, or null for a pid lock.

lease_until.description: Epoch ms the holder lease ends, or null for a pid lock.

line.description: The one line the text mode prints: `unit: <prompt>` or `stop: <code> <reason>`.

code.description: 0 = a unit is due; otherwise the stop code (10, 20, 30, 40, 75).

reason.description: The stop reason, its first word an outcome or stop word; null when a unit is due.

ledger.description: The active mission ledger path, or null.

budget.description: The active ledger's five budget fields (mission-budget.sh semantics), or null with no active ledger.

due_in_s.description: Seconds until the backoff allows the next round (0 = now).

begin.description: runner.mjs begin --json: the round is started and the lock is held.

prompt.description: The child turn's prompt: the unit slash command alone (it expands only when it opens the prompt).

append_system_prompt.description: The round rules (docs are the source of truth, Docs vs code, the gh token rule, the ask note); pass as --append-system-prompt.

env.description: Variables the caller adds to the child env (it also deletes CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT, AGENTIC_WORKFLOW_CHILD and the two Anthropic key variables).

events_path.description: Where the caller writes the turn's stream-json (0600; never surfaced).

state_digest.description: sha256 of the protected set at begin. Keep it in memory and pass it to record --digest; it is never written to disk.

classify.description: runner.mjs classify --json: a finished turn mapped to the exit contract (pure: no lock, no spawn).

tokens.description: input + output + cache_creation + cache_read from the last result event; the tick budget when the turn reported no usage.

record.description: runner.mjs record --json: the round's one update under the lock (the lock is released).

line.description: The round: line written to rounds.log (or the state-tampered stop line).

stop.description: The STOP reason this record wrote (crash-loop, no-progress, state-tampered <file>), or null.
